author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm planning to leave for Europe next week.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 haa5 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 au1 zau1。
text: 我諗住下個禮拜去歐洲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My father does not always walk to work.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 m4 hai6 jat6 jat6 dou1 haang4 lou6 faan1 gung1 gaa3。
text: 我阿爸唔係日日都行路返工㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This is a difficult math problem.

jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hai6 jat1 tiu4 hou2 sam1 ge3 sou3 hok6 tai4。
text: 呢條係一條好深嘅數學題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Linda stuck her tongue out.

jyutping: lam4 daat6 san1 zo2 tiu4 lei6 ceot1 lai4。
text: 琳達伸咗條脷出嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Are you students?" "Yes, we are."

jyutping: 「nei5 dei6 hai6 m4 hai6 hok6 saang1 lai4 gaa3？」「hai6 aa3。」
text: 「你哋係唔係學生嚟㗎？」「係呀。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom enjoys playing tricks on me.

jyutping: aa3 Tom hou2 zung1 ji3 zing2 gu2 ngo5。
text: 阿Tom好鍾意整蠱我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That shop has many customers.

jyutping: go2 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 bong1 can3。
text: 嗰間舖頭有好多人幫襯。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They lost their way; otherwise, they would have arrived long ago.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sat6 hai6 dong6 sat1 zo2 lou6 laa1，jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 jing1 goi1 dou3 zo2 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa3。
text: 佢哋實係蕩失咗路啦，如果唔係佢哋應該到咗好耐㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: All the apples that fall are eaten by the pigs.

jyutping: dit3 lok6 lai4 di1 ping4 gwo2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 bei2 di1 zyu1 sik6 saai3。
text: 跌落嚟啲蘋果全部都俾啲豬食晒。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The garden was larger than I had expected.

jyutping: go3 faa1 jyun2 bei2 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 daai6。
text: 個花園比我想像中大。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You'd better brush up on your English if you 're going to go to America.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 mei5 gwok3 ge3 waa2，nei5 zeoi3 hou2 lin6 hou2 nei5 di1 jing1 man2 sin1。
text: 如果你諗住去美國嘅話，你最好練好你啲英文先。

author: kaenif

english.text: The situation there was critical.

jyutping: go2 dou6 cing4 fong3 hou2 ngai4 gap1。
text: 嗰度情況好危急。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He gave his seat to the old man.

jyutping: keoi5 joeng6 zo2 go3 wai2 bei2 go3 lou5 jan4 gaa1。
text: 佢讓咗個位俾個老人家。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Get the fuck out!

jyutping: sei2 lan2 hoi1 laa1！
text: 死撚開啦！

author: nickyeow

english.text: We hope to reach the summit before it gets dark.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 hai2 tin1 hak1 zi1 cin4 soeng5 dou3 saan1 deng2。
text: 我哋希望可以喺天黑之前上到山頂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We're still the best in the world.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jing4 jin4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 dai6 jat1。
text: 我哋仍然係世界第一。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The beach was crowded with tourists.

jyutping: go3 saa1 taan1 bik1 mun5 saai3 jau4 haak3。
text: 個沙灘逼滿晒遊客。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wonder if Tom is telling the truth.

jyutping: m4 zi1 aa3 Tom hai6 mai6 gong2 gan2 zan1 waa2 ne1。
text: 唔知阿Tom係咪講緊真話呢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who am I? Where do I come from? Is there life after death? What is the meaning of life on earth?

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 bin1 go3？ngo5 hai2 bin1 dou3 lai4？jan4 sei2 zo2 zi1 hau6 wui5 m4 wui5 cung4 sang1？hai2 dei6 kau4 soeng6 sang1 cyun4 jau5 me1 ji3 ji6？
text: 我係邊個？我喺邊到嚟？人死咗之後會唔會重生？喺地球上生存有咩意義？

author: kaenif

english.text: I was expecting it!

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 kei4 doi6 gan2 gaa3 laa3！
text: 我一路期待緊㗎喇！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Does this dress make me look fat?

jyutping: ngo5 zoek6 ni1 tiu4 kwan4 mong6 lok6 wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 fei4 aa3？
text: 我着呢條裙望落會唔會好肥呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is not a good driver.

jyutping: keoi5 sau2 ce1 m4 hai6 hou2 dim1。
text: 佢手車唔係好掂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We're newcomers.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 san1 lai4 gaa3。
text: 我哋新嚟㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm a fatalist.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 suk1 ming6 leon6 ze2。
text: 我係一個宿命論者。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Existence is a meaningless concept.

jyutping: cyun4 zoi6 hai6 jat1 go3 mou5 ji3 ji6 ge3 koi3 nim6。
text: 存在係一個冇意義嘅概念。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm looking for books on the history of Rome.

jyutping: ngo5 wan2 gan2 di1 gwaan1 jyu1 lo4 maa5 lik6 si2 ge3 syu1。
text: 我搵緊啲關於羅馬歷史嘅書。

author: clowergen

english.text: Our delay was due to traffic congestion.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai6 jan1 wai6 sak1 ce1 sin1 ci4 dou3。
text: 我哋係因為塞車先遲到。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom loves talking to people.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 gin6 taam4。
text: 阿湯健談。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I didn't have a ticket.

jyutping: ngo5 mou4 fei1 wo3。
text: 我無飛喎。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: A doghouse is a house for a dog.

jyutping: gau2 uk1 hai6 bei2 gau2 zyu6 ge3 uk1。
text: 狗屋係畀狗住嘅屋。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: None of this is personal.

jyutping: ne1 joeng2 je5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 hai6 si1 si6。
text: 呢樣嘢完全唔係私事。

english.text: Mackinac Island, Michigan is the only city in the United States where there are no motorized vehicles of any kind on the streets. It's been that way since the automobile was banned by city ordinance in 1898. The island's thousands of tourists go from place to place in horse-drawn taxi cabs. But the island's commitment to a unique way of life is being threatened by its own success.

jyutping: mat6 hit3 gan1 zau1 ge3 mak6 gei1 naap6 hak1 dou2 hai6 mei5 gwok3 wai4 jat1 jat1 go3 hai2 gaai1 dou6 soeng6 mou5 jam6 ho4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 gei1 dung6 ce1 ge3 sing4 si5，zi6 cung4 1898 nin4 sing4 si5 tiu4 lai6 gam3 zi2 hei3 ce1 zi1 hau6，ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 zau6 jat1 zik6 hai6 gam2。dou2 soeng6 ge3 seng4 cin1 soeng5 maan6 jau4 haak3 heoi3 dou3 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1 daan6 hai6 ni1 go3 dou2 deoi3 duk6 dak6 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1 ge3 sing4 nok6 zing3 sau6 dou3 keoi5 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing4 gung1 ge3 wai1 hip3。
text: 密歇根州嘅麥基納克島係美國唯一一個喺街道上冇任何類型嘅機動車嘅城市，自從1898年城市條例禁止汽車之後，呢個情況就一直係咁。島上嘅成千上萬遊客去到唔同嘅地方 但係呢個島對獨特生活方式嘅承諾正受到佢自己嘅成功嘅威脅。

english.text: When now the Gods have made proud Ilion fall, / and Asia's power and Priam's race renowned / o'erwhelmed in ruin undeserved, and all / Neptunian Troy lies smouldering on the ground, / in desert lands, to diverse exile bound, / celestial portents bid us forth to fare; / where Ida's heights above Antandros frowned, / a fleet we build, and gather crews, unware / which way the Fates will lead, what home is ours and where.

jyutping: dong1 ji4 gaa1 zung3 san4 ji5 ging1 ling6 dou3 giu1 ngou6 ge3 ji1 lei6 ngong4 do6 lok6， / ji4 aa3 zau1 ge3 lik6 loeng6 tung4 pou2 lei5 aa3 mou5 ge3 zung2 zuk6 ceot1 meng2 / bei6 wai2 mit6 hai6 m4 zik6 dak1 ge3，ji4 so2 jau5 / hoi2 wong4 sing1 dak6 lok6 ji1 dou1 tong2 hai2 dei6 soeng6， / hai2 saa1 mok6 tou2 dei6 soeng6，bei6 gok3 zung2 lau4 fong3， / tin1 soeng6 ge3 jyu6 siu6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 ceot1 heoi3 ling1 ce1 fai3； / hai2 on1 taan2 dak1 lo4 si1 ji5 soeng6 ge3 ji1 daat6 gou1 cyu3 zau3 mei4， / ngo5 dei6 gin3 zou6 jat1 go3 laam6 deoi2，tung4 maai4 zeoi6 zaap6 di1 syun4 jyun4，m4 zi1 / ming6 wan6 wui6 daai3 ling5 bin1 go3 fong1 hoeng3，ngo5 dei6 ge3 gaa1 hai6 me1，hai2 bin1 dou6。
text: 當而家眾神已經令到驕傲嘅伊利昂墮落， / 而亞洲嘅力量同普里亞姆嘅種族出名 / 被毀滅係唔值得嘅，而所有 / 海王星特洛伊都躺喺地上， / 喺沙漠土地上，被各種流放， / 天上嘅預兆叫我哋出去拎車費； / 喺安坦德羅斯以上嘅伊達高處皺眉， / 我哋建造一個艦隊，同埋聚集啲船員，唔知 / 命運會帶領邊個方向，我哋嘅家係咩，喺邊度。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The people of Galilee are not precise in their speech. What does this mean? There was a certain man of Galilee who would say, "Who has amar? Who has amar?" They would say to him, "Foolish Galilean, do you mean a donkey (ḥamor) to ride, or wine (ḥamar) to drink, wool (amar) to wear or a lamb (imar) to slaughter?"

jyutping: gaa1 lei6 lei6 jan4 ge3 syut3 waa6 m4 zing1 kok3。ni1 go3 hai6 me1 ji3 si1？jau5 jat1 go3 gaa1 lei6 lei6 jan4 wui6 waa2：「bin1 go3 jau5 aa3 maa5？bin1 go3 jau5 aa3 maa5？」keoi5 dei6 wui6 tung4 keoi5 gong2：「jyu4 ceon2 ge3 gaa1 lei6 lei6 jan4，nei5 hai6 zi2 jat1 zek3 jiu3 ke4 ge3 lou4（ḥamor），ding6 hai6 jiu3 jam2 ge3 zau2（ḥamar），jiu3 zoek6 ge3 joeng4 mou4（amar），ding6 hai6 jiu3 tou4 zoi2 ge3 joeng4 gou1（amar）？」
text: 加利利人嘅說話唔精確。呢個係咩意思？有一個加利利人會話：「邊個有亞瑪？邊個有亞瑪？」佢哋會同佢講：「愚蠢嘅加利利人，你係指一隻要騎嘅驢（ḥamor），定係要飲嘅酒（ḥamar），要着嘅羊毛（amar），定係要屠宰嘅羊羔（amar）？」
